title: Tiny Trails: Space
tagline: Trace a twinkly trail through ten cosmic worlds.
summary: A calm tracing game for ages 3 to 6. Follow a glowing path across little planets and meet the star at the end.
description: Trace a glowing trail through cosmic worlds. A calm game for ages 3 to 6 with no ads and no accounts.

art_alt.card: Tiny Trails: Space, a glowing stardust path across a soft lavender moon
art_alt.hero: A chibi astronaut beside a glowing trail on a lavender moon, with a smiling star ahead
screens: A small astronaut tracing a glowing trail across a moon path
Three tiny planets: a butter-yellow sun, a mint Earth, and a teal moon
A chibi astronaut hugging a smiling butter-yellow star

free_content: Free Play, the Sun, Earth, and Moon worlds, and the explorers Astro and Zog.
unlock: Every explorer and all 10 worlds. No subscription.
highlights: Trace the path with a finger. The trail lights up as the explorer moves.
Free Play plus the Sun, Earth, and Moon worlds are included from the start.
Astro and Zog are free. The other explorers are part of the one-time unlock.
No ads, no accounts, and no personal data.
